# Blue Jay — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is the scientific name of the Blue Jay?", "Cyanocitta cristata"),
    ("What does the Blue Jay eat?", "nuts"),
    ("What is scientific name?", "Cyanocitta cristata"),
    ("What is size?", "28 cm"),
    ("What is habitat?", "N. American forest"),
    ("What is diet?", "nuts"),
    ("What is range?", "North America"),
    ("What is notable?", "Mimics hawk calls to scare competitors"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
